llm_response.reason: The website presents itself as a DeFi support solution but lacks any evidence of a legitimate company, privacy policy, or contact information. It pushes users to connect their wallet to solve severe issues (missing funds, locked accounts, migration trouble), a common scam tactic to hijack wallets. The site uses urgency and high-impact pain points, offers fake large numbers solved, and has no outbound links, making it a closed victim funnel. Hosted on a disposable 'web.app' subdomain widely used for scams. All these strongly match cryptocurrency scam characteristics.
